messages:
noah_sales: FYI we just received a ticket from HelixAI — p95 on their dedicated pool jumped from ~180ms to ~820ms after the latest rollout. They reported it around 09:30 UTC. Theyre expecting an update within 24h.

sana_pm: thanks, Noah. Can you attach sample request ids & whether they use burst or autoscale? Also which model variant they pinned to before the rollout?

noah_sales: sample ids DM'd. They're on autoscale with burst=1. They said they weren't changed anything on their side.

irina_eng: quick check: there was a routing-policy push at 08:45 UTC introducing a low-precision quantized variant and a fallback rule for lower-cost tiers. Could be related. I'll pull metrics for HelixAI's pool.

mike_oncall: looking now: HelixAI's worker queues increased between 08:50-09:10 UTC and we saw higher batching and GPU compute stalls. Trace ids added.

lucy_support: HelixAI saw a few 429s reported before the spike. Customer-facing note prepared: we can do a temporary route pin to previous variant while we investigate. Need PM ok.

telemetry_bot: auto-report: HelixAI p95 spike 09:30 UTC -> alerted oncall. Dashboards: increased batch size, serving-agent CPU jitter.

sana_pm: short-term: approve route-pin for HelixAI + scale headroom if needed. Medium-term: rollback fallback globally, add gating checks for rollout of quantized variants, and add perf regression test focused on cold starts for quantized binaries.

irina_eng: I can apply the route-pin and open PR for rollback. Quick mitigation: route-pin + release additional +1 node for 1 hour.

mike_oncall: on itrouting pin applied at 10:05 UTC for HelixAI. Monitoring.

lucy_support: customer reply: "noted, we'll monitor."

noah_sales: please cc me on updates. This customer has an enterprise deal in renewal.

sana_pm: created backlog item PROD-4901 (P2): "quantized fallback can increase p95 on dedicated pools". Owner=irina_eng, milestone=hotfix, acceptance: p95 normalized in canary & telemetry per-variant present.

irina_eng: PR open: https://git.redwood/infra/routing/pull/349. Will run canary.

mike_oncall: canary shows p95 back to baseline for HelixAI within 8 minutes.

telemetry_bot: HelixAI p95 normalized at 10:15 UTC.
